title: case.open
description: Opens a forensic case from a single evidence source (disk image, memory capture, logs, or network capture). Creates an isolated sandbox and registers the case in the FIND EVIL orchestrator.

image_path.description: Absolute path to disk image on SIFT host. Must be under /evidence/.

mem_path.description: Absolute path to memory dump on SIFT host. Must be under /evidence/.

pcap_path.description: Absolute path to PCAP network capture on SIFT host. Must be under /evidence/.

logdir_path.description: Absolute path to log directory on SIFT host. Must be under /evidence/.

inputSchema.description: Input must specify exactly one evidence source. All paths must be absolute and under /evidence/ on the SIFT host.

case_id.description: UUID v4 case identifier. Used as namespace for all subsequent operations.

sandbox_root.description: Absolute path to case sandbox directory. All case data isolated under this tree.

accepted_inputs.description: Array containing single accepted input spec.

outputSchema.description: Case opening result with isolated sandbox root and evidence registration.

x-mcp-capability.name: case.open
x-mcp-capability.description: Register and sandbox a forensic evidence source.
constraints: All input paths must start with /evidence/ (SIFT host perspective)
All output paths must start with /cases/ (orchestrator perspective)
No shell access; no arbitrary file read/write
Case sandbox is read-write for case.open only; other tools are read-only on evidence, write-only on /cases/<id>/report/
